rag.text:
Test: TC-1122 — Feature area - Box scope - Trello - Add new connection
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-25 Feature area - Box scope - Own scope definition
Labels: manual, teamextplatform

Steps:
1. Navigate to configuration -> tasks -> scope definition of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1122 Feature area - Box scope - Trello - Add new connection
   Expected: Scope definition tab is opened and visible
2. Click on the "Add new integration" button
   Expected: "Add new integration" dialogue opens
3. Expend "Integration", select Trello and click on add new connection
   Expected: A new tab opens with Trello authorization page

NOTE: This step requires alLowing pop-ups in the browser
4. Log in to Trello using your Trello account and select "AlLow" to permit the connection
   Expected: The Trello tab closes and the user is back on the Scope definition
5. Select  Workspace which you want to connect and click "Connect" button
   Expected: The Field mapping configuration tab is opened
6. Click on " start working" button
   Expected: The scope definition of box is opened, the Trello connection is visible
7. Expend section with Trello connection -> and add any available board to the scope -> click save buton
   Expected: The Trello board is added to the scope and visible
8. Navigate to Gantt module of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-1122 Feature area - Box scope - Trello - Add new connection
   Expected: Gantt module is opened correctly. Trello tasks are visible in WBS
9. Navigate to App settings -> integrations -> connections
   Expected: Connections section is opened, Trello integrations is visible and have status "OPERATIONAL"
